name: shared-complex-atoms-five-case-three-seed-v1
model: CM93 positive dimension-bias image of CM92 complete learned shared complex atoms
interface: immutable object sequence to one next original object; IDs have no arithmetic meaning
data: unchanged original frozen35 splits and fingerprints, data seed1; training sampler/component seeds1,2,3
sampler: all original example batches, masks, duplicates and short tails; Random(seed+10000)
component_rng: Random(seed+20000), separate from the original data sampler
training: ordinary answer CE; complete minibatch gradient or feasible finite CE queries at the same shrunken centre; running full-coordinate momentum; approximate complex component search; convex CE line search
stopping: fixed update count; every endpoint in both modes sealed before any held-out scoring
success: retain original success; report raw and exact >=99% separately
limitations: approximate component oracle, no convergence guarantee; five original cases, three training seeds on original fixed data; higher-context parity restriction unchanged; preserve transformer and all frozen producers
geometry_rule: query and context bias scale 1/sqrt(original_objects); all other coordinates one; no labels
query_reservation: same raw logit step h, reserve h/(query_bias_scale*context_bias_scale) in both modes
execution: CM94 exact zero-row contractions; retain full gradient and all learned factor coordinates, no magnitude threshold
